fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description:
Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields parsed from ld+json plus a direct-child

HTML body scrape; latest-mode records (S2-rss, the site's working WordPress /feed/) carry title/link-style fields including a real reporter byline (creator) and the full RSS content:encoded HTML body.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json block.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from div.content-single-wrap's direct-child

paragraphs.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date from ld+json NewsArticle block.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date from ld+json NewsArticle block.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL, as emitted in ld+json NewsArticle block.

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Section/category list from ld+json (e.g. ['News'], ['Art & Culture', 'Entertainment']). HTML-unescaped.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream paywall metering flag from ld+json.

_paywalled.title: Paywalled
_paywalled.description: True when isAccessibleForFree is explicitly false.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS feed.

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: RSS item GUID -- on this site, points at an internal newsmemory.com URL, not the public article URL (use `link` instead).

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Reporter byline from RSS dc:creator -- typically 'Name Title email@jamaicaobserver.com' as one raw string.

category.title: Category
category.description: First RSS <category> value for the item (e.g. 'News').

contentEncoded.title: Content (encoded)
contentEncoded.description: Full article body HTML from the RSS content:encoded field.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
